definitions.explanation: An organization that provides financial services such as banking, lending, insurance, or investment management.

examples.japanese: {金融機関|きんゆうきかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: To open an account at a financial institution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金融機関|きんゆうきかん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{融資|ゆうし}→融資：04775_yuushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: We are receiving loans from multiple financial institutions.

examples.japanese: {金融機関|きんゆうきかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦マネー→マネー：29549_manee⟧ロンダリング⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}する→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧よう⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧ (finance) + ⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧ (institution, organization). A broad term encompassing banks, credit unions, insurance companies, securities firms, and other organizations that handle financial transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金融機関|きんゆうきかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧: to deposit at a financial institution
- {金融機関|きんゆうきかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: counter at a financial institution
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{金融機関|きんゆうきかん}: designated financial institution

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧: bank — the most common type of financial institution
- ⟦{信用金庫|しんようきんこ}→信用金庫：24783_shinyoukinko⟧: credit union — a smaller, community-based financial institution
